name: Rock Rumble
hook: Blast the rocks. Blast each other. Three ships.
how: Thrust and turn through a field that wraps at every edge. Big rocks split into smaller, faster ones worth more points. Down another ship for 200. You get three ships a run; touch a rock or a bullet and you lose one.
controls: Arrow keys or the mouse to turn, Up or right-click to thrust, Space or click to shoot; thumb stick and FIRE on touch
uses: Each player's best score in one run of three ships.
The host's browser flies the rocks and decides who broke them; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bot ships fill the field until enough people join.
Every ship, rock and bullet moves for everyone at once; whoever gets hit says so.
